min.description: Minimum estimated budget in rupees (major units). Stored as paise server-side.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the budget

integrations.description: Third-party APIs or services to integrate

title.description: Succinct and descriptive title for the request
title.example: Build a Custom CRM for Real Estate

description.description: Detailed explanation of the project scope and requirements

category.description: The primary service category for this request

attachments.description: Array of media/file UUIDs for any supporting documentation provided by the client

referencePortfolioItemId.description: Published portfolio item that inspired this request

title.description: Succinct and descriptive title for the request
title.example: Build a Custom CRM for Real Estate

description.description: Detailed explanation of the project scope and requirements
description.example: We need a robust CRM system to manage lead flow, automated emails, and agent performance tracking...

category.description: The primary service category for this request

attachments.description: Array of media/file UUIDs for any supporting documentation provided by the client

additionalInfo.description: Any other relevant information not captured in the description or technical requirements
additionalInfo.example: We prefer a phased rollout with the MVP being ready by Q1.

referencePortfolioItemId.description: Published portfolio item that inspired this request

servicePackageId.description: Optional service catalog package this request is based on

status.description: The new target status: draft (editable), submitted (awaiting review), underReview, quoted, accepted, rejected, convertedToProject, changesRequested

notes.description: Administrative reason or context for the status transition
notes.example: Moving to review after client confirmation of budget.

description.description: Detailed description of the service or component

quantity.description: Quantity or hours for the item

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in major currency (e.g. ₹2,500.00). Stored as paise server-side.

percentage.description: Percentage of quote total (use this OR amount, not both required)

amount.description: Fixed amount in major currency (e.g. rupees). Use when not using percentage.

dueDate.description: Due date (required when dueTrigger is on_date)

prefillFromPackage.description: When true and request has servicePackageId, prefill items from package deliverables if items is empty.

includePackageAddOns.description: Include optional add-ons from service package when prefillFromPackage is true

items.description: List of line items comprising the quote total (billing breakdown)

schedulePreset.description: Built-in payment schedule preset. Used when paymentSchedule is omitted. Defaults to 50-50.

paymentSchedule.description: Custom payment installments (amounts in major currency or percentages). Overrides schedulePreset.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the quote

taxPercentage.description: Tax percentage to apply to the subtotal

termsAndConditions.description: Project-specific terms added on top of the platform standard terms (payment milestones, scope boundaries, client responsibilities, etc.)
termsAndConditions.example: 30% deposit on acceptance. Client provides brand assets within 5 business days of kickoff.

internalNotes.description: Internal administrative or project management notes

requiresContract.description: Whether client must sign contract before deposit (enterprise clients)

revisionsIncluded.description: Number of revision rounds included in this quote

additionalRevisionCost.description: Overflow fee per additional revision in major currency (paise stored server-side)

applyClientTierDiscount.description: When true, apply the client tier discount (e.g. VIP 10%) to computed list-price totals. Default false — never silently rewrite admin totals (NL-BUG-PAY-001).

sourceQuoteId.description: Source quote UUID to copy structure from

content.description: The textual content of the note
content.example: Initial draft looks good, but need more clarity on the cloud provider requirements.

assigneeId.description: User id of an active admin to assign this request to

basePricePaise.description: Price in paise (preferred for seed payloads)

basePrice.description: Price in major currency units (e.g. INR)

id.description: Stable UUID when seeding known IDs
